acceptance.given: Package A implementation and test changes are prepared within the declared Toolchain scope.

oracle.expected: The changed-path inventory and scope-boundary check show no modifications under PhaseA.Platform/**, PhaseA.Platform.Tests/**, runtime/**, live metadata or hosted workspaces, Phase authentication/authorization, or the Runner.
forbidden: Any changed file under PhaseA.Platform/** or PhaseA.Platform.Tests/**
Any changed file under runtime/**, live metadata, or hosted workspaces
Any change to Phase authentication/authorization or the Runner
oracle.observable: Repository changed-path inventory and boundary-validator result evaluated after assembling the Package A change set

acceptance.then: The scope-boundary check reports all named Phase, runtime, live-workspace, authentication/authorization, and Runner boundaries untouched.
acceptance.when: After assembling the Package A change set, run the repository scope-boundary validation against changed paths.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the existing scope-boundary validator against a change set containing a file under a forbidden Phase or runtime boundary; it must fail with an observable boundary diagnostic.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Verify that Package A implementation and test changes remain outside all named Phase service, runtime, live workspace, authentication/authorization, and Runner boundaries.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No Phase service, runtime, live workspace, authentication, authorization, or Runner state or schema may change; remove only any out-of-scope Package A edits if detected.

slice_hint.state_transition: Package A change set transitions from unverified scope to scope-validated with forbidden boundaries untouched.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Boundary validation passes and the changed-path inventory contains no forbidden boundary path.
